summary.text: Kyle Moore, a Republican, has represented Illinois's 99th House District since January 2025, having been elected in November 2024, according to the General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: His General Assembly biography says he earned a bachelor's degree in business management from Quincy University and is a former co-owner and vice president of a family business.

It says Moore served on the Quincy City Council, was elected Mayor of Quincy in 2013 and re-elected in 2017, and became president of the Great River Economic Development Foundation in 2021. He lives in Quincy.
